key_insight: Nano- and micro-textures in perovskite solar cells not only improve light management but also enhance film wetting, crystallinity, and mechanical stability.
engineering_relevance: These textures provide a holistic approach to improving solar cell performance and durability.
method: Review of recent findings on texture-related benefits in perovskite solar cells.
Evaluation of effects on film wetting, crystallinity, and carrier extraction.
Analysis of mechanical stability in flexible devices.
evidence_signal: The article reviews multiple benefits beyond light management, highlighting improved film wetting and enhanced carrier extraction.
watch_item: Further research is needed to fully understand the long-term stability of textured surfaces in real-world conditions.
paper_title: More than just light management -- The multiple advantages of nano- and micro-textures in perovskite solar cells
